senses.gloss:
REQUEST (v.): प्रार्थयते (अर्थ्, c. 10.): v. To
ask (II), beg, entreat.

REQUEST (subs.):
(1) प्रार्थना
or
अभ्यर्थना, r. s to
stronger (men)
end in evils:
प्रार्थनाधिकबले विपत्फला,
Ki. xiii. 61.;
(2) याच्ञा,
it is better that a r.
to a good man is unsuccessful:
याच्ञा मोघा
 वरमधिगुणे, Me. i. 6.;
(3) याचितम्, प्र- (rare).

REQUIRE:
I To ask, demand: q. v.: प्रार्थयते।
II To need, call for: अपेक्षते (ईक्ष्, c. l.),
r. s you as the best cause:
अपेक्षते प्रत्ययमुन्त्तमं त्वाम्,
Ku. iii. 18.

REQUIREMENT: expr. by verb,
all her r. s were
supplied:
यदेव वव्रे तदपश्यदाहृतम्, R. iii. 6.: v.
Requisition.

REQUISITE:
(1) आवश्यकीय (f. या = necessary:
q. v.);
(2) by verb: v. To require (II).

REQUISITION:
(1) अनुयोगः (= demand);
(2) []
प्रार्थना (= request). Ph.:
to be in r.:
अपेक्षते:
v. To require.

REQUITAL:
I Retaliation, punishment:
(1)
प्रति (ती) कारः;
(2) प्रतिक्रिया।
II Reward, com-
-pensation: q. v.

REQUITE:
I To retaliate, punish: q. v.:
प्रतिकरोति।
II To reward, repay: निर्यातयति
(c. of यत्).
